mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with positive RSAFS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness, leading to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply chain, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2% annualized, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Real Final Sales (RSAFS) and Housing Starts (HOUST) both increase, it signals a broad-based demand expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 2% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with an increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp and PAYEMS increases > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp and PAYEMS increases > 100k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of economic expansion, a rise in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
